positive.description: Search the scoped catalog, calculate full-match statistics and preserve exact predicates in a website link.
positive.prompt: Find active GPW RR corporate bonds in PLN maturing from 2027-01-01 through 2030-12-31, sorted by maturity ascending. Show the total matching series and distinct issuer counts, report known and missing annual coupons, and give me a website link preserving these filters. Page through results if needed rather than treating the first page as the whole catalog.
positive.expected_behavior: Search and statistics use the same exact predicates over the visible active corporate GPW RR catalog. Counts describe all matching data, not only returned rows. Missing values remain unknown and overlapping groups are not double-counted. The website link preserves the filters and ordering. Results are factual and informational; no live quote or investment recommendation is invented.

positive.description: Discover issuers by scoped series count and retrieve issuer and selected bond details.
positive.prompt: List issuers by the number of active corporate GPW RR series, largest count first. For the first issuer, retrieve its issuer details and available series, then fetch the details for up to two exact series keys from those results. Show missing fields explicitly. Do not interpret a series count as debt value or company size.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant resolves the exact issuer identifier from discovery before fetching details, and uses returned series keys for the batch request. Pagination and missing keys are explicit. Counts remain scoped catalog series counts. No assessment of present issuer health or personalized suitability is claimed.

positive.description: Read cached document metadata, summaries, typed facts and topic context with page citations and evidence gaps.
positive.prompt: Select one active corporate GPW RR bond with available reviewed document evidence. List its source-document metadata, read the cached summaries, search typed facts about early redemption, and retrieve topic context for issuer call and investor put rights. Explain only what the reviewed sources establish, cite each contractual claim by document and page, and state gaps or conflicts without treating missing facts as proof that no right exists.
positive.expected_behavior: The selected bond comes from the scoped catalog. Metadata is distinguished from contents. Available cached summaries, facts and topic context retain provenance, extraction state, source pages, missing evidence and conflicts. No new extraction is promised. Uncited summaries are context only. Contract clauses are not presented as current covenant compliance, executed payments or proof that security has been created. If reviewed evidence is unavailable, that limitation is reported instead of inventing clauses.

positive.description: Search and read the curated knowledge base while preserving the Treasury education boundary.
positive.prompt: Find and read an English obligacje.io knowledge article explaining how corporate bonds differ from Polish retail Treasury bonds. Summarize the educational explanation and link to the article. Read further paragraphs if needed. Do not claim the corporate catalog contains Treasury instruments or that an article provides current market data.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant sends locale en to knowledge_search and knowledge_get, reads the actual published English article text, follows pagination with the same locale when needed, cites its direct English article URL and answers in English. Treasury discussion is educational knowledge. The answer does not invent Treasury catalog records, current rates, live prices or investment advice.

positive.description: Delegate one focused informational question to the account-bound assistant with minimal context.
positive.prompt: Ask the obligacje.io assistant in Polish to explain a floating-rate corporate bond coupon and why contractual coupon rules alone do not establish today's fixing or current coupon. Send only this focused question and necessary page context, not our conversation history.
positive.expected_behavior: Exactly one focused assistant request is sent with locale pl and only necessary context. A private conversation is created in the signed-in obligacje.io account and consumes its existing assistant allowance. The answer is informational, distinguishes terms from current observations and states that it may contain errors. It uses available citations and gaps without claiming current fixing data. On a timeout, permission or allowance failure, the failure is explained without automatic retry, fabricated success or an upsell.

negative.description: An unrelated user request should not activate the bond integration.
negative.prompt: Write a four-line poem about autumn rain. Do not use any external tools.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant responds to the writing request without invoking obligacje.io tools or sending the request to its assistant.

negative.description: A personalized investment recommendation or brokerage action should not activate this informational integration.
negative.prompt: Tell me exactly which bond I should buy with my retirement savings and place an order for it at the current live market price. Do not provide a catalog comparison or educational explanation.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant declines to choose a personal investment or execute an order, and accurately states the informational scope and absence of brokerage and live-price functionality. It does not invoke obligacje.io tools, invent a price or claim to have placed a trade.

negative.description: A request for retail Treasury instrument records should not activate the corporate catalog integration.
negative.prompt: Use the obligacje.io corporate bond catalog to list currently offered Polish retail Treasury instruments (EDO and COI) and their catalog records. I only need instrument records, not educational articles.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant explains that Polish retail Treasury instruments are outside the active corporate GPW RR catalog and cannot be retrieved as catalog records through this integration. It invokes no obligacje.io tool, invents no Treasury records or current offer data, and does not claim trading functionality. Treasury educational knowledge remains a separate supported use case when requested.
